text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, Mejiro 
McQueen came walking toward me, looking 
unwell...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My head... How did this even 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I am quite all right. Yes, there is no 
problem whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I 
shall endure a mere headache such as 
this...

And so, Mejiro McQueen found herself 
plagued by a headache...
